editorial:
Ever feel like your job is more than just doing your actual work? You will totally relate to that in this story. It follows a young woman who is just trying to keep her head above water at her office job. Things get weird when she finds out her boss is not just a tough manager, but a guy whose marriage is falling apart. To keep her paycheck, she ends up becoming an accidental therapist and fixer for his personal life. It is a lighthearted, funny ride that looks at how messy the line between professional and personal life can get, and it keeps you laughing at how awkward the situations become.

The acting is great and the dialogue feels like things people actually say. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, though some of the plot points are a bit predictable. If you want something easy to watch after a long day, this is a perfect choice. You can catch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you might want to rent it on Apple TV if you are on the go. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for a cozy movie night.
endingExplained: In the end, the main character realizes she cannot spend her whole life fixing other people's problems just to keep a job. She finally stands up for herself and tells her boss that his marriage is his own responsibility to fix. This honesty actually helps the boss and his wife start talking for real. She finds a better balance in her career, and the boss learns to be a better partner and manager.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward office comedies and stories about young adults finding their way.
